name: RestBench
description: A high-quality benchmark consisting of two real-world scenarios with human-annotated instructions and gold solution paths to evaluate large language models' ability to connect with and utilize RESTful APIs for complex task completion.
reputation: A niche but practical benchmark for evaluating LLM tool use and REST API interaction, with growing interest in agentic evaluation.
notes: Designed to evaluate LLMs' abilities in task decomposition, API selection, and execution in realistic RESTful API scenarios.
